featured_reviews.review_text: I did a workshop on School Counselling with Pooja Ma'am. It was a wonderful and very insightful session. featured_reviews.name: Ruchita Uchil
featured_reviews.review_text: I wanted to share some feedback on the advanced school counseling workshop conducted in July 2025. While I appreciated the effort put into organizing it, I felt that the content could have been more aligned with the title's promise of advanced level discussions. The majority of the sessions focused on foundational theories, which, while important, didn't quite meet my expectations for an advanced workshop. I would have liked to see more time dedicated to therapy and interventions, particularly those relevant to working with teenagers. The facilitator's presentation style was clear, but I think more concrete examples and case studies would have enhanced the learning experience. I'm hopeful that future workshops will build on this experience and provide even more valuable insights and practical strategies for participants.
